title: Add EmailSubmission query filter types (RFC 8621 §7.2)
description: RFC 8621 §7.2 defines a separate filter condition for EmailSubmission/query. Fields: identityId (Id), emailId (Id), threadId (Id), undoStatus (String/UndoStatus), before (UTCDate), after (UTCDate). This is simpler than Email/query filter — only a condition struct, no nested operator support needed (spec does not define FilterOperator for submissions). jmap-mail-server will need this to implement EmailSubmission/query.
design: EmailSubmissionFilter struct, all fields Option. Uses existing UndoStatus enum for undoStatus field. No Filter union needed — the spec defines only a flat filter object for submissions.
